title: FIRST LIGHT
concept: A jewel-colored young bird discovers a much bigger sky: curiosity, courage, wonder, adversity, release, belonging.
style: Original sculptural 3D animation, layered feathers, botanical dioramas, luminous atmospheric depth, cinematic camera moves, and warm storybook narration. No stock footage or slides.
implementation: One seek-safe Three.js stage shares the hero rig across eight camera shots. The timeline has a single 60s root; this avoids multiple WebGL contexts and preserves bird identity.

shots.name: The awakening
shots.action: Bird blinks and looks into sunrise from a mossy flowering branch.

shots.name: The leap
shots.action: Anticipation, takeoff, layered wings opening; flight through giant ferns.

shots.name: River ribbons
shots.action: Hero and golden companion skim shimmering turquoise water.

shots.name: Coral ballet
shots.action: An elegant flock of flamingos grazes while the tiny bird passes overhead.

shots.name: Into the weather
shots.action: Bird beats against rain and slate clouds, then turns upward.

shots.name: A world above
shots.camera: Ascending cloud reveal into wide orbit
shots.action: Breakthrough into golden blue light, wings spread above a sea of clouds.

shots.name: Not alone
shots.action: Bird joins a sweeping murmuration silhouetted against sunset.

shots.name: First light, endless sky
shots.action: Companions glide toward the sun; title resolves over the living final image.
